summary: Tested admin property panel end-to-end (backend + UI). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_properties.py — POST /api/auth/login (200 + HttpOnly foxy_bo_session cookie), GET /api/admin/properties (401 unauth, 200 authed), POST /api/admin/upload (200, returns {path,url}), GET /api/media/<path> serves image/jpeg, POST /api/admin/properties (201) with schema fields {title,description,area,price,propertyType,listingType,bedrooms,bathrooms,sizeSqft,status,photos}, PUT & DELETE work, public GET /api/properties includes LIVE admin properties (image=/api/media/...) alongside 3 prototype items (prototype:true, image:null). UI: /admin renders data-testid=admin-login-form; unauth GET /admin/properties redirects to /admin. Login with admin@foxyproperty.co.uk / Sa281616@ redirects to /admin/properties. Filled form via pf-* testids, saved via admin-save, new row appeared in admin-property-list with admin-edit-/admin-toggle-/admin-delete- controls that all functioned (edit reloads title into pf-title, toggle flips status, delete removes row after confirm). /properties page renders all requested testids: listing-all/buy/rent, filter-location, filter-bedrooms, filter-type, price-min, price-max, price-label ('£0 — £5m+'), filter-clear, results-count ('3 RESULTS' with 3 prototype cards, 0 when listing-rent since prototypes are buy-only). Filter-clear resets. Regression: /admin-login page still reachable.

minor.issue: Public list only includes LIVE admin properties (listProperties(true)); COMING_SOON admin properties are excluded. Requirement states 'a COMING_SOON one still lists (status label)'. Fix: use listProperties(false) or add explicit filter so COMING_SOON admin properties still appear with their status label like the prototypes do.

ui_bugs.issue: No visible thumbnail preview after selecting a file via pf-photos before saving — no element appears alongside the form (still saves successfully). The requirement explicitly asks for a thumbnail preview.

action_items: In /app/src/app/api/properties/route.ts, include COMING_SOON admin properties in the public list (call listProperties(false)) so they render on /properties with a COMING SOON status label, mirroring prototype behaviour.
Render an image thumbnail preview in AdminProperties.tsx after files are chosen in pf-photos (and after existing property photos load in edit mode).
critical_code_review_comments: Public /api/properties currently silently drops non-LIVE admin properties — divergent from the review-request expectation. Either update the copy or the query.

Admin properties schema uses propertyType while the review request mentions pf-type; testids align but field names are inconsistent between prototype list (type) and admin schema (propertyType) — acceptable but worth noting.
Photo upload flow could benefit from a preview + remove-photo control; currently the user has no visual confirmation until save.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows pass; photo thumbnail preview + COMING_SOON public listing are gaps)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a TEST admin property (UI + backend) — no residual test data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://dev-foxy-pull.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin panel path is /admin (login) → /admin/properties. Admin schema field is propertyType (not type). Public /api/properties uses listProperties(true) so only LIVE admin props are visible; toggling to COMING_SOON hides them from /properties (may be intentional post-fix). Regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. UI testids present: admin-login-form, pf-title/description/area/price/type/listing/beds/baths/size/status/photos, admin-save, admin-property-list, admin-edit-<id>/admin-toggle-<id>/admin-delete-<id>, property-card-<slug>, listing-all/buy/rent, filter-location/bedrooms/type/clear, price-min/max/label, results-count.
